entries.title: supporting documents
entries.statement: Supporting documents: process.md, architecture.md, design-system.md, testing-guidelines.md, api.md, openapi.yaml, and the three team role files.

entries.title: context loading strategy
entries.statement: The agent loads documents on demand based on task type: backend endpoint, frontend UI, testing, PM grooming, QA verification.

entries.title: role summary
entries.statement: PM produces groomed issue (no code); SWE produces code + tests + commit; QA produces PASS/FAIL comment (no code).

entries.title: ErrorResponse schema
entries.statement: Errors return `{detail, code, field?}` with detail human-readable, code machine-readable, field optional.

entries.title: validation error normalization
entries.statement: Validation errors return 422 with the first error normalized to `{detail, code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR', field}`.

entries.title: HTTP status usage
entries.statement: 200 for GET/PUT, 201 for POST, 204 for DELETE, 401 for missing/invalid token, 403 for forbidden, 404 for missing or not-owned, 409 for conflict, 422 for validat

entries.title: schema validation in tests
entries.statement: Integration tests assert response shapes match OpenAPI schemas.

entries.title: 404 for cross-user
entries.statement: Cross-user access returns 404, not 403, to avoid revealing existence.

entries.title: budget missing returns 200
entries.statement: A missing budget returns 200 with amount '0.00', simplifying the frontend.

entries.title: Frontend layered structure
entries.statement: The frontend is organized into entry, pages, components, hooks, context, API, utils, and types layers.

entries.title: Backend layered structure
entries.statement: The backend is organized into entry, config, database, routers, services, models, schemas, auth, audit, and core layers.

entries.title: Login flow
entries.statement: Login flow: user enters credentials → frontend POST /auth/login → backend verifies bcrypt → signs JWT → returns token and user → frontend stores token and redir

entries.title: Repository root structure
entries.statement: The repository root contains README, product-spec, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, openapi.yaml, docker-compose.yml, render.yaml, Makefile, .env.example, .gitignore, LICE

entries.title: Frontend directory structure
entries.statement: The frontend contains `src/` with api, components, pages, hooks, context, types, utils, test; plus `public/`, config files, and Dockerfile.

entries.title: Documentation and artifacts structure
entries.statement: `docs/` contains architecture, api, process, ai-workflow, design-system, testing-guidelines, agent-extension-pack, permissions, task-template, and team/. `secur

entries.title: Security cross-cutting
entries.statement: Passwords use bcrypt, tokens use HS256 with env secret, token validation covers signature/exp/aud/iss, all queries filter by user_id, cross-user access returns

entries.title: Testing cross-cutting
entries.statement: Backend unit, backend integration, frontend unit, frontend component, and E2E tests exist in their respective locations.

entries.title: Agent layer uses same API
entries.statement: The agent layer calls the same backend API with the same JWT, with no special endpoints.

entries.title: Month selector in context
entries.statement: The selected month lives in MonthContext, enabling global chart synchronization.

entries.title: layer responsibilities
entries.statement: Each layer has defined responsibilities: entry (orchestration), config (settings), database (engine), routers (parsing), services (business), models (ORM), sche

entries.title: dependency direction
entries.statement: Dependencies point inward: main → routers → services → models

entries.title: audit rules
entries.statement: Same transaction, rollback on failure, no API access, preserve on user delete, JSON-serializable values, IP address extracted from request.

entries.title: never log sensitive data
entries.statement: Passwords, tokens, full bodies, raw emails, and DB connection strings are never logged.

entries.title: user isolation and 404
entries.statement: User isolation is enforced at the query level; cross- user access returns 404, not 403, to avoid revealing existence.

entries.title: UUID primary keys
entries.statement: All tables use UUID primary keys generated in Python, not by the database.

entries.title: all foreign keys
entries.statement: All five foreign key relationships are defined with the specified ON DELETE behavior (CASCADE for user_id, RESTRICT for category_id, no cascade for audit_logs.u

entries.title: date rules
entries.statement: Expense date uses DATE with no timezone; created_at and updated_at use TIMESTAMPTZ in UTC; year_month uses CHAR(7) with no timezone.

entries.title: primary key choice
entries.statement: UUID primary keys generated in Python for portability across PostgreSQL and SQLite.

entries.title: amount type choice
entries.statement: NUMERIC(12,2) for exact decimal representation.

entries.title: date type choice
entries.statement: DATE avoids timezone ambiguity for month attribution.

entries.title: budget key choice
entries.statement: (user_id, year_month) ensures one budget per user per month.

entries.title: audit entity_id choice
entries.statement: UUID without FK, supporting multiple entity types and surviving deletion.

entries.title: layer responsibilities
entries.statement: Entry (bootstrap), pages (route composition), components (reusable UI), hooks (data fetching), context (global state), API (HTTP), utils (pure functions), types

entries.title: import direction
entries.statement: Pages may import anything below them; components may not import pages; hooks may not import components or pages; API modules may not import React; utils are pur

entries.title: provider responsibilities
entries.statement: QueryClientProvider (server cache), BrowserRouter (routing), AuthProvider (user/token), MonthProvider (yearMonth), ToastProvider (toast queue).

entries.title: hook list
entries.statement: Auth, categories, expenses (list/get/create/update/ delete), budgets (get/set/delete), dashboard (six queries), toast.

entries.title: typography
entries.statement: Page title `text-2xl font-semibold`, section title `text-lg font-semibold`, KPI value `text-3xl font-bold`; system font stack; `tabular-nums` for tables and KPI

entries.title: spacing scale
entries.statement: Page padding `px-6 py-8`, card padding `p-6`, card gap `gap-6`, section gap `space-y-8`, form gap `space-y-4`, max width `max-w-7xl mx-auto`.

entries.title: component specifications
entries.statement: Button variants (primary/secondary/danger/ghost) with defined backgrounds; Card with border and shadow; Input with focus ring and error state; Modal with overla

entries.title: chart colors
entries.statement: Pie uses category colors; trend bars `#3B82F6`; cumulative line `#3B82F6` normal and `#EF4444` over budget; budget reference `#9CA3AF` dashed; heatmap five-step

entries.title: chart accessibility
entries.statement: Each chart is wrapped in `<figure>` with a `<figcaption>` and `role='img'` `aria-label` summarizing key values.

entries.title: performance budget
entries.statement: Initial JS bundle < 300 KB gzipped, CSS < 30 KB gzipped, Lighthouse performance > 85, FCP < 1.5s, TTI < 3s.

entries.title: test structure
entries.statement: Tests live beside source with `.test.ts(x)` suffixes; utils, charts, forms, and pages have tests.

entries.title: coverage targets
entries.statement: Utils 90%+, charts 80%+, forms 80%+, pages 60%+, API modules mocked (not tested directly).

entries.title: test examples
entries.statement: Tests exist for formatUSD, BudgetProgress color logic, WeeklyHeatmap cells, CategoryPieChart merging, ExpenseForm validation, LoginPage validation and errors.

entries.title: centralized API choice
entries.statement: All API calls go through `src/api/`.

entries.title: out-of-scope frontend features
entries.statement: Dark mode, i18n, SSR, PWA, analytics are not in MVP.

entries.title: diagnosis verification
entries.statement: Verification steps include register, login, create expense, list expenses.

entries.title: phase dependencies
entries.statement: Phases are sequential; Phase 4 and Phase 5 may run in parallel.

entries.title: phase 1 deliverables
entries.statement: product-spec.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, process.md, team/, task-template.md, repo skeleton, groomed backlog, backend and frontend skeletons, root config files.

entries.title: phase 2 verification
entries.statement: Register, login, token, duplicate email, wrong password, frontend login, frontend redirect, tests pass.

entries.title: phase 5 tasks
entries.statement: 15 tasks: Dockerfile, Compose, health check, SQLite fallback, render.yaml, three workflows, Playwright setup, three E2E specs, first deploy, UptimeRobot, deploy

entries.title: phase 8 verification
entries.statement: README under 500 lines; all docs present; screenshots exist; all tests pass; live URL works; criteria mapped.

entries.title: milestones
entries.statement: Eight milestones M1–M8 aligned with the eight phases, each with a criteria statement.

entries.title: technical risks
entries.statement: Ten technical risks documented with probability, impact, and mitigation: Render PostgreSQL expiry, cold start, pi-agent struggles, context limit, MCP failure, E

entries.title: process risks
entries.statement: Seven process risks: spec vague, spec detailed, AI wrong code, review skipped, issues too large, correction not written, session records incomplete.

entries.title: scope risks
entries.statement: Six scope risks: feature creep, extra charts, multi-currency, shared budgets, mobile, dark mode.

entries.title: deployment risks
entries.statement: Six deployment risks: deploy failure, migration failure, cold start, bandwidth, build minutes, secret leak.

entries.title: time allocation
entries.statement: Writing code 40%, reviewing AI output 20%, grooming 10%, testing 15%, docs 10%, debugging 5%.

entries.title: phase structure
entries.statement: Eight phases, sequential with Phase 4 and 5 parallel- izable, estimated 25 days.

entries.title: Accessibility
entries.statement: Form inputs have labels, buttons have accessible names, modal has role and focus trap, charts have descriptions, contrast is at least 4.5:1, keyboard navigation

entries.title: Maintainability
entries.statement: Backend is split into routers, services, models, schemas; frontend into api, components, pages, hooks, context, utils; all API calls are centralized; all busine

entries.title: Functional success
entries.statement: A new user can register, log in, record expenses, set a budget, and view the dashboard without errors; all five charts render; month switching updates all chart

entries.title: Quality success
entries.statement: README provides a 5-minute verification path; all 14 criteria have evidence; security artifacts are present; Agent Extension Pack is functional; AI workflow is

entries.title: In-scope capabilities
entries.statement: The MVP includes authentication, expenses, budgets, categories, dashboard with five visualizations, data integrity, SQLite fallback, Agent Extension Pack, secur

entries.title: validation rules
entries.statement: Validation rules for email, username, password, amount, category_id, date, note, year_month, page, page_size, months, weeks, limit, color.

entries.title: SQL injection prevention
entries.statement: All database access uses SQLAlchemy ORM with parameterized queries; no raw SQL in application code.

entries.title: XSS prevention
entries.statement: React escaping, no `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`, no third-party scripts; CSP not configured in MVP (documented).

entries.title: MCP security
entries.statement: JWT verification, token from env, no database access, strict tool schemas, exception handling, no token logging.

entries.title: hook security
entries.statement: validate_amount prevents invalid amounts; validate_ownership prevents cross-user access; both also enforced in backend.

entries.title: auth and token choices
entries.statement: bcrypt rounds 12; HS256; localStorage; 24-hour expiry; no refresh token; 404 for cross-user.

entries.title: audit choices
entries.statement: Audit write same transaction; no API access.

entries.title: symlink purposes
entries.statement: Each symlink has a defined target and purpose.

entries.title: file count summary
entries.statement: The project totals approximately 230 files across root, CI/CD, frontend, backend, E2E, docs, security, ops, agent extension, and screenshots.

entries.title: file naming
entries.statement: React components PascalCase.tsx; hooks camelCase.ts with `use` prefix; TypeScript modules camelCase.ts; test files same name + `.test.ts(x)`; Python modules sna

entries.title: directory naming
entries.statement: Feature directories lowercase; Python packages snake_case; agent tool directories kebab-case; docs subdirectories lowercase.

entries.title: monorepo choice
entries.statement: Single repository with top-level frontend, backend, e2e, docs, security, ops, and agent directories.

entries.title: agent directories choice
entries.statement: Agent capabilities, hooks, MCP, and custom-agent live in their own top-level directories with symlinks in `.agents/`.

entries.title: tests beside code
entries.statement: Frontend tests use `*.test.ts(x)` beside source; backend tests separate in `tests/unit/` and `tests/integration/`.

entries.title: no extra tooling
entries.statement: No `src/` at root; no Turborepo or Nx; flat layout.

entries.title: Frontend date utilities
entries.statement: The frontend uses date-fns 3 for date manipulation.

entries.title: GitHub Actions pinning
entries.statement: GitHub Actions are pinned to major versions (e.g., `actions/checkout@v4`).

entries.title: four test layers
entries.statement: Testing is organized into four layers: backend unit (pytest), backend integration (pytest + httpx), frontend unit/component (Vitest + RTL), and end-to-end (Play

entries.title: testing principles
entries.statement: Tests assert behavior not implementation, one assertion per concept, independent, deterministic, fast by default, realistic integration, isolated E2E.

entries.title: backend test structure
entries.statement: Backend tests live in `backend/tests/` with `conftest.py`, `unit/`, and `integration/` subdirectories.

entries.title: expenses API tests
entries.statement: `test_expenses_api.py` verifies create, negative amount, zero amount, three decimals, requires auth, pagination, invalid page, page_size too large, update, dele

entries.title: budgets API tests
entries.statement: `test_budgets_api.py` verifies set budget, get nonexistent returns 0, invalid year_month, delete budget, delete nonexistent returns 404.

entries.title: format tests
entries.statement: `format.test.ts` verifies `formatUSD` for integer, decimal, large with commas, zero, negative; `formatPercent` for whole, decimal, null; `formatMonth`.

entries.title: BudgetProgress tests
entries.statement: `BudgetProgress.test.tsx` verifies green under 80%, yellow 80-100%, red over 100%, caps at 100%, 'No budget set' when budget 0, formatted amounts.

entries.title: WeeklyHeatmap tests
entries.statement: `WeeklyHeatmap.test.tsx` verifies 7 days rendered, grey for zero, handles max zero, shows skeleton when loading.

entries.title: CategoryPieChart tests
entries.statement: `CategoryPieChart.test.tsx` verifies empty state, renders with data, merges to Other when > 6 categories.

entries.title: ExpenseForm tests
entries.statement: `ExpenseForm.test.tsx` verifies empty amount error, negative amount error, three decimals error, cancel callback.

entries.title: LoginPage tests
entries.statement: `LoginPage.test.tsx` verifies fields render, invalid email error, invalid credentials error.

entries.title: backend test data
entries.statement: Backend unit and integration tests use in-memory SQLite with seeded system categories; test users created per test via fixtures.

entries.title: frontend test data
entries.statement: Frontend unit tests use pure functions; component tests use MSW handlers with fixed data; page tests use MSW variants.

entries.title: E2E test data
entries.statement: E2E tests use the real backend and database with unique users per test.

entries.title: framework choices
entries.statement: pytest for backend, pytest + TestClient for integration, SQLite in-memory, Vitest for frontend, RTL for components, MSW for API mocking, Playwright for E2E.

entries.title: execution choices
entries.statement: Coverage reported not enforced; CI runs unit + integration; E2E only on main; per-test fixtures; Decimal comparison; fixed dates.

entries.title: error testing
entries.statement: Error tests assert both status code and error code.
